title.zh: 在 Metal 里写入压缩纹理
title.en: Writing to Compressed Textures in Metal

subtitle.zh: Metal 没有资源视图转换，那就用 heap 让纹理和缓冲区别名同一块内存，并按 Morton 序把块写进正确的位置。

translator.note: 源文有 4 张基准测试表被归档压成「一行一个单元格」，均已对照原始 HTML 还原为一个 `code` 块（`lang: "text"`）、空格对齐列并保留表头行（第 1 张表头是 `method / best / average`，后 3 张是 `method / best / avg`），所有方法名、耗时数值与单位逐字未改。`**iPhone 16 (A18):**`、`**iPhone 8 (A11):**` 两行粗体小标题按规范提升为 `h2`。唯一一张插图按全站口径归一化为 `![图](原图URL)`。代码围栏在源文里都没有语言标注：前两段是 Objective-C 侧的 Metal API 调用，标为 `objc`；后三段是 Metal Shading Language（`morton10` 辅助函数与两个 kernel），标为 `metal`；围栏内容逐字保留、注释也未译。`lang: "text"` 的 4 个块是表格，不属于源码。术语：`tile` 作「图块」，但 `texture tiling`、`macro tile`、`block-linear`、`swizzle`/`swizzling` 按本批口径作「纹理 tiling」「macro tile」「block-linear」「通道重排」；`endpoint` 未出现；`hazard tracking` 作「危险追踪」并保留英文原词；`fence` 作「围栏」；API/格式名（Metal、Vulkan、D3D12、`MTLHeap`、`MTLHeapDescriptor`、`MTLTextureDescriptor`、`MTLStorageModePrivate`、`MTLHeapTypePlacement`、`MTLHazardTrackingModeUntracked`、BC7、`MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm`、Morton、BC）保留英文。原文副标题缺失，`subtitle.zh` 是译者概括的。

blocks.en: About a year ago I wrote [GPU Texture Compression Everywhere](https://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2025/02/gpu-texture-compression-everywhere/#metal), a post in which, among other things, I lamented that Metal did not have support for writing to compressed textures.
blocks.zh: 大约一年前我写过一篇 [GPU Texture Compression Everywhere](https://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2025/02/gpu-texture-compression-everywhere/#metal)，在那篇文章里，除了别的内容，我还抱怨了 Metal 不支持写入压缩纹理。

blocks.en: Unlike Vulkan or D3D12, Metal doesn’t support resource casting. There’s no way to write to a compressed texture through an uncompressed view. The only way we can do that is by using a blit operation, so we need to output our results to a temporary buffer and then copy the contents of the buffer to the texture. This requires a temporary memory allocation that needs to be managed, and if the buffer is reused for multiple uploads, hazard tracking may add some synchronization overhead.
blocks.zh: 和 Vulkan 或 D3D12 不同，Metal 不支持资源视图转换（resource casting）。你没有办法通过一个未压缩的视图去写入压缩纹理。唯一的办法是用一次 blit 操作，也就是先把结果输出到一个临时缓冲区，再把缓冲区的内容拷贝到纹理里。这需要一块必须自己管理的临时内存分配；而且如果这个缓冲区被多次上传复用，危险追踪（hazard tracking）还可能带来一些同步开销。

blocks.en: I requested support for this feature to Apple when I started working on Spark, more than 3 years ago. Since then not much progress has been made, and support is still not available, so I decided it was time to take matters into my own hands.
blocks.zh: 我三年多前刚开始做 Spark 的时候，就向 Apple 提过希望支持这个功能。从那以后进展不多，支持依然没有提供，所以我决定该自己动手了。

blocks.en: The workaround I came up with is to emulate resource casting by using a Metal heap to allocate the two resources at the same memory location:
blocks.zh: 我想出的变通办法是用一个 Metal heap，把两个资源分配在同一块内存位置上，以此模拟资源视图转换：

blocks.en: We then write to the buffer and read from the texture. With fences to synchronize access, we can ensure writes are visible before sampling:
blocks.zh: 然后我们写入缓冲区、从纹理读取。配合围栏（fence）来同步访问，就能确保写入在采样之前可见：

blocks.en: However, for this to work the codec needs to read the input texture and write to the output buffer taking texture swizzling into account. For an overview of how texture tiling works, I recommend Fabian’s post: [Texture Tiling and Swizzling](https://fgiesen.wordpress.com/2011/01/17/texture-tiling-and-swizzling/)
blocks.zh: 不过要让它跑起来，编解码器在读取输入纹理、写入输出缓冲区时，必须把纹理的通道重排（swizzling）考虑进去。关于纹理 tiling 的原理，我推荐 Fabian 的这篇文章：[Texture Tiling and Swizzling](https://fgiesen.wordpress.com/2011/01/17/texture-tiling-and-swizzling/)

blocks.en: To determine the tiling order on Apple silicon, I wrote blocks with increasing color values and read back the buffer to observe the storage order. On the M4 (the machine I’m writing this on), the GPU uses the following approach for BC blocks: The texture is divided into macro tiles (32×32 blocks, or equivalently 128×128 pixels) arranged in row-major order. Within each macro tile, blocks are stored in X-first Morton order.
blocks.zh: 为了确定 Apple 芯片上的 tiling 顺序，我写入了一系列颜色值递增的块，再把缓冲区读回来观察存储顺序。在 M4 上（也就是我写这篇文章时用的机器），GPU 对 BC 块采用如下做法：纹理被划分为若干 macro tile（32×32 个块，等价于 128×128 像素），按行主序排列。每个 macro tile 内部，块按 X 优先的 Morton 序存放。

blocks.en: ![图](https://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/metal-alias-card.jpg)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）

blocks.en: There are two ways to write a texture encoder that produces swizzled output: Read 4×4 pixel blocks linearly and scatter writes, or gather reads and write compressed blocks linearly. For each approach need to either compute the linear address for a 2D coordinate, or the 2D coordinate of a linear address.
blocks.zh: 要写一个产出通道重排后输出的纹理编码器，有两条路：按线性顺序读取 4×4 像素块、把写入打散；或者聚集读取、按线性顺序写入压缩块。这两种做法都需要由二维坐标算出线性地址，或者反过来由线性地址算出二维坐标。

blocks.en: For that we need to compute Morton codes efficiently, and Fabian also has an article covering that subject: [Decoding Morton Codes](https://fgiesen.wordpress.com/2009/12/13/decoding-morton-codes/)
blocks.zh: 为此我们需要高效地计算 Morton 码，Fabian 同样有一篇文章讲这个主题：[Decoding Morton Codes](https://fgiesen.wordpress.com/2009/12/13/decoding-morton-codes/)

blocks.en: In our case we only need to interleave the lower 5 bits of each coordinate to index within a macro tile. We can do this efficiently by packing both coordinates into a single word, x in bits 0–4 and y in bits 16–20, and then spreading or compacting both halves in parallel through the same shift-and-mask chain. This lets us encode or decode both coordinates in a single pass:
blocks.zh: 在我们的场景里，只需要把每个坐标的低 5 位交错起来，用于在 macro tile 内部定位。做法可以很高效：把两个坐标打包进同一个字，x 放在第 0–4 位、y 放在第 16–20 位，然后让两半并行地经过同一条移位-掩码链去展开或压缩。这样就能一趟完成两个坐标的编码或解码：

blocks.en: For the version that writes blocks in swizzled order, we use a 2D kernel. Threads form a 2D grid over the (bx, by) block coordinates. Each thread reads its 4×4 input block in scan order and writes the encoded BC7 block at the swizzled buffer offset.
blocks.zh: 对于「按通道重排后的顺序写入块」的那个版本，我们用二维 kernel。线程在 `(bx, by)` 块坐标上构成二维网格。每个线程按扫描顺序读入自己的 4×4 输入块，再把编码后的 BC7 块写到缓冲区里通道重排后的偏移上。

blocks.en: For the version that reads blocks in swizzled order, we use a 1D kernel. Threads form a 1D grid over the linear slot indices in the buffer. Each thread reverses the swizzle to find the (bx, by) block coordinates it owns, reads that 4×4 block from the input texture, then writes the encoded block at its own linear slot.
blocks.zh: 对于「按通道重排后的顺序读取块」的那个版本，我们用一维 kernel。线程在缓冲区的线性槽位索引上构成一维网格。每个线程反解通道重排，求出自己负责的 `(bx, by)` 块坐标，从输入纹理读出那个 4×4 块，再把编码后的块写到自己的线性槽位上。

blocks.en: I measured the performance of both approaches and compared them with the standard method using a temporary buffer and a blit. I ran each method 100 times on an M4 at quality level 2 and report the best and average times for a 1024×1024 texture:
blocks.zh: 我测量了这两种做法的性能，并与「用临时缓冲区加一次 blit」的标准做法做了对比。每种方法都在 M4 上、质量等级 2 下跑了 100 次，下面报告 1024×1024 纹理的最佳与平均耗时：

blocks.code:
method           best      average
writes_swizzled  0.020 ms  0.036 ms
reads_swizzled   0.021 ms  0.038 ms
linear + blit    0.025 ms  0.043 ms

blocks.en: The two swizzled variants are closely tied. On smaller textures `writes_swizzled` tends to win, on larger textures `reads_swizzled` pulls ahead, but the difference is negligible either way.
blocks.zh: 两种通道重排变体不分伯仲。在较小的纹理上 `writes_swizzled` 往往胜出，在较大的纹理上 `reads_swizzled` 会反超，但两者的差别可以忽略不计。

blocks.en: Both outperform the blit approach by around 20%, an improvement that you don’t want to overlook. At quality level 1 the kernel is purely bandwidth limited and the difference is even more pronounced, approximately 28% faster:
blocks.zh: 两者的表现都比 blit 做法好大约 20%，这个提升你可不想视而不见。在质量等级 1 下 kernel 完全受带宽限制，差距更明显，大约快 28%：

blocks.code:
method           best      avg
writes_swizzled  0.013 ms  0.026 ms
reads_swizzled   0.014 ms  0.026 ms
linear + blit    0.018 ms  0.036 ms

blocks.en: On mobile the differences are more muted, but still worthwhile at around 17% improvement.
blocks.zh: 在移动端差距更温和一些，但大约 17% 的提升仍然值得。

blocks.en: iPhone 16 (A18):
blocks.zh: iPhone 16（A18）：

blocks.code:
method           best      avg
writes_swizzled  0.168 ms  0.257 ms
reads_swizzled   0.170 ms  0.245 ms
linear + blit    0.201 ms  0.304 ms

blocks.en: iPhone 8 (A11):
blocks.zh: iPhone 8（A11）：

blocks.code:
method           best      avg
writes_swizzled  0.578 ms  0.606 ms
reads_swizzled   0.573 ms  0.593 ms
linear + blit    0.689 ms  0.721 ms

blocks.en: Despite the benefits, this technique is somewhat risky. There’s no guarantee that future devices will use the same tiling format, in fact, some of the iOS devices I’ve tested use a different Morton ordering.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些好处，这项技术还是有些风险。无法保证未来的设备会沿用同样的 tiling 格式；事实上，我测过的一些 iOS 设备使用的就是另一种 Morton 序。

blocks.en: It’s also interesting to note that in Vulkan, some (most?) vendors disable tiling when writes to compressed textures are enabled, resulting in textures that are in a block-linear format. To avoid that they would have to modify every shader that writes to those textures in order to apply the swizzling, which would require dynamic shader compilation.
blocks.zh: 同样有意思的是，在 Vulkan 里，当启用「写入压缩纹理」时，有些（大多数？）厂商会关掉 tiling，结果纹理就变成了 block-linear 格式。要避免这一点，他们就得修改每一个会写入这些纹理的着色器来施加通道重排，而这需要动态编译着色器。

blocks.en: When sampled, block-linear textures have worse caching performance than swizzled textures. I haven’t measured the impact, and IHVs have dismissed this concern, but I think it’s worth taking a closer look at this in the future and implementing a similar approach in Vulkan.
blocks.zh: 采样时，block-linear 纹理的缓存表现比通道重排后的纹理更差。我没有测过影响有多大，厂商们也否认这是个问题，但我认为将来值得仔细看看，并在 Vulkan 里实现一套类似的做法。

blocks.en: The drawback is that you would need slightly different code paths depending on the target device, but hey, that’s why you want to license [Spark](https://ludicon.com/spark/), rather than rolling your own.
blocks.zh: 代价是你得根据目标设备走稍有不同的代码路径，不过嘿，这正是你要去授权 [Spark](https://ludicon.com/spark/)、而不是自己造轮子的原因。

blocks.en: The upcoming Spark SDK will include a Metal example demonstrating this technique in more detail, with support for non-power of two textures, different block-compression formats, and devices as old as iPhone 6 (A8).
blocks.zh: 即将发布的 Spark SDK 会包含一个 Metal 示例，更详细地演示这项技术，并支持非 2 的幂尺寸的纹理、不同的块压缩格式，以及像 iPhone 6（A8）这样老的设备。
